objects.description: [Silence](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0091) has used the Farse6.1 utility (based on [Mimikatz](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0002)) to extract credentials from lsass.exe.(Citation: Group IB Silence Sept 2018)
